_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
O iko na Dauqito {player_id} ena Tic Tac Toe ni Tolu Dauqito.
Na iqaqalomu e '{symbol}'.
O ni dauqito vata ena borodi ni 5x5 me vakarautaka na laini ni va.
Na laini e rawa ni veidigidigi, veitarataravi, se veiqiqo.
Solia na veiqitomu ena fomu ni '[4]' me biuta na seli 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Na ivakarau ni toso e sega ni dodonu. Vakayagataka na "[cell]" ena vanua sa 0-{max_cell} kina na vale lalai.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Na nambari ni seli e sega ni dina: {cell}. Me vakawati ena 0 kei {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Na dauqito {player_id} e cakava na kena sega ni dodonu.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} e vakaraitaka na itukutuku ni nona ({symbol}) ena vanua ({row}, {col}).
